name: Citizenship by Naturalization

requirements.blocker_text: Lei n. 2/16 (Nationality Law): a foreign citizen must accumulate at least 10 years of legal residence in Angola, demonstrate moral and civic integration, show proof of regular income for the past 3 years, pass a Portuguese-language exam, demonstrate an 'effective connection to the national community' (tested knowledge of the people and nation), understand constitutional rights and duties, and have no conviction carrying a sentence of 3+ years' imprisonment. Naturalization is granted by the President of the Republic, per secondary reporting -- not an automatic administrative grant once conditions are met.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 10 years of legal residence, document 3 years of regular income, pass the Portuguese-language and civic-integration assessments, and maintain a clean record, before Presidential grant of naturalization.

requirement_groups.name: Married to an Angolan citizen under a community-property regime

requirements.blocker_text: Lei n. 2/16, Article 13: a foreigner married to an Angolan citizen for over 5 years under a community-property marital regime may request citizenship. Separately, a foreign spouse who acquires Angolan nationality through marriage and loses their prior nationality in the process also acquires Angolan nationality under this article -- a specific mechanic tying the marriage-based route to loss of the original nationality.
requirements.fix_path: Marry an Angolan citizen under a community-property regime, maintain the marriage for over 5 years, and apply.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 10 years' legal residence (or 5 years' qualifying marriage)

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: 10 years continuous legal residence (5 years if married to an Angolan citizen under a community-property regime)

STATUS: DRAFT -- LEX.AO hosts the law's text directly but is a private database (tier 3), not a .gov.ao original; the official gazette copy (via SAFLII) returned a 403 error on every attempt. GENUINE FINDING: at 10 years, Angola's standard naturalization residency requirement is more than triple Paraguay's and Bolivia's (both 3 years, built earlier in this session) -- one of the longer standard residency bars found in this dataset. GENUINE, EXPLICIT FINDING: Article 32 states plainly that 'no other nationality attributed to Angolan citizens is recognized or produces effects in Angolan legal order' -- an unambiguous rejection of dual citizenship, applied here as false with high confidence relative to several other countries in this dataset where the answer is genuinely unclear or conditional. The marriage-based route requires the marriage be under a COMMUNITY-PROPERTY regime specifically -- a real, disclosed condition, not automatic for any marriage to a citizen regardless of matrimonial regime chosen.
